brief: A small-parts organizer with at least six separate bins.

requirements.evidence: A compact hex cluster: 7 base pieces (one centre, six around it) on level 0, joined by joint bolts, with open faces capped.
7 separate hex-bin-full-div3 trays (bin:0,0,0 plus bins at -1,0; -1,1; 0,-1; 0,1; 1,-1; 1,0), one per cell. Each tray has 3 compartments, which suits small parts.

finish.summary: Built a small-parts organizer: seven separate full-depth, three-compartment bins in a hex cluster of seven base cells, locked with joint bolts and capped at open faces. check_build reports no issues and meshClash is clear. No props were added since the brief is about the storage, not use.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
